authorization: Operator requests the most suitable next single goal and execution. Goal-tool scope fixed before detailed root PDF review; this file is a retrospective source-intake freeze, not a prospective experimental preregistration.
question: Does a new native atom-pair to molecule protocol supply independently phase-referenced analyzer information on the same pre-readout state, sufficient to admit EXCH004's measurement packet?
new_input: Single-pair optical-tweezer preparation and a native Raman or spin-motion association protocol, rather than the already-audited Donley gas. Better preparation is a reason to inspect, not proof of analyzer calibration.

protocol_slots.native_target: A normalized native pair coherence associated with m_dagger*a_Na*a_Cs, not b_dagger*a^2 or the full EXCH pair sum.
Heteronuclear rubidium spin-motion association; full operator and instrument remain unassessed without the full paper.

cheap_first_filters: Actual pair-to-molecule conversion, not molecular rotational or motional Ramsey or an unrelated qubit
Same pre-readout state with distinct analyzer setting, or an independently justified state-change map
Analyzer phase relative to current-generating coupling independently justified, not merely coherent light or a fitted Rabi curve
Full detector, normalization, leakage/loss and control/backaction instrument
Joint uncertainty or independently justified conservative joint bounds, plus separately role-frozen unused outcomes

scope.TECT: All original P1/PAH/EXCH definitions and time laws preserved. EXCH's side16 periodic T3, each fixed K>=1, Q11008/27 and Hamiltonian tau are reference-only, not identified with laboratory atoms.
scope.native: Source-declared finite optical-trap preparation and laboratory time. No exact fixed pure preparation is inferred from postselection or cooling.
scope.normalization: Heteronuclear pair operator and count convention must be source-justified; do not import homonuclear sqrt(2) or factor-of-two current coefficients.
scope.limits: No new regulator, volume, continuum, infinite-time or cosmological limit. No numerical response fitting, phase reconstruction or new finite carrier.

decision_rule.PASS: One actual complete phase-referenced packet admits target reconstruction and independently error-controlled unused-response validation.
decision_rule.DISPROVED: An exact contradiction in an admitted native state/instrument contract, not absent data or inaccessible full text.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: No complete packet established in the bounded intake. Distinguish source-scoped missing calibration from unassessed inaccessible evidence.

non_claims: No full P1/EXCH physical identity, new state/model/time, ideal analyzer, mean-field factorization, damping, empirical holdout, native impossibility, PreA, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum or TOE.
